correctness.rationale: PASS: At f(z)=z²/2, lambda=1, the inexact minimizer p^a=x/2+e is admissible iff e²<=eps, F^a=x²/4+e², g^a=x/2-e. At x0=1/10, e0=-9/20, eps0=1/4, obtain F^a_0=41/200, g0=1/2, d0=-1/2. At eps1=1/5 both +/-2/5 are admissible. For 0<alpha<3/5 the negative-error branch gives g_trial=9/20-alpha/4>3/10>sigma*g0=1/4, violating Wolfe curvature. For alpha>=3/5 positive-error branch makes Armijo equivalent to 25alpha²+15alpha-17<=0, false there (value 1 already at 3/5 and increasing). Exact independent rational checks reproduce the branch values; finite grid is not needed for the universal proof. Applies to Algorithm 1 under arbitrary admissible oracle selection, not every continuous concrete solver.
